Own a small slice of heaven right here in Central Texas!  This property features a fully fenced 3.99 acres with a 1BR and 1BA home. This home has all new Whirlpool appliances, crown molding, custom cabinets, an on-demand water heater, ceiling fans, vinyl plank flooring, and carpet. The owners planted 21 trees on the property which will mature and look beautiful in a few years. Enjoy gardening in your 30’X30’ fenced garden. 
The owners put in a new road to the home from the electric gate. Once parked, walk down the crushed granite walkway to the home. Walk inside and you will be pleasantly surprised by the workmanship and design. This lovely property is only 15 minutes from Gatesville or Temple, 20 minutes to the Air Field Gate at Fort Cavazos, and 5 minutes to North Fort Cavazos. This property has so many possibilities, or just enjoy it as it is! Call your favorite realtor today.
